stage_progress.title: Launch Surface Audit & Critical Flow Closure
goals: inventory executable visitor and operator launch surfaces from repository authority
classify findings strictly as launch_blocker, post_launch or insufficient_evidence
close only bounded defects that prevent primary launch flows

stage_progress.title: Production Safety & Recovery Closure
goals: reuse Stage 19 deployment, health, queue, rollback and backup/restore ownership
verify production preflight, migrations, secrets and runtime dependencies
prove safe degradation and isolated recovery without a new control plane

stage_progress.title: Discoverability & Public Trust Minimum
goals: verify Stage 18.3 canonical URLs, robots, sitemap and structured metadata against release reality
close only launch-critical indexability and public-trust defects
defer growth integrations and broad SEO polish until evidence exists

stage_progress.title: Production Candidate & Launch Closure
goals: run production-equivalent exact-head verification on the release candidate
close Stage 28 while keeping production promotion human-controlled

work_lease_policy.authority: live Git branch + GitHub pull request
work_lease_policy.rule: Never store volatile PR/head state as authored progress. AI must resolve the live branch/PR before writing; an existing active PR for the same semantic owner is resumed instead of duplicated. Stage work uses one umbrella branch while logical tranche ownership remains explicit in this plan.
